purpose: Deterministic actions available to the PUR-NEW decision Agent before it freezes a recommendation.

actions.name: query_external_priors
actions.description: Retrieve curated analogue evidence from the external PUR database. Use this to learn admissible formulation motifs and approximate modifier-fraction regions without reading held-out wet-lab outcomes.
when_to_use: before selecting a formulation family
when considering resin/tackifier modification
when local evidence is sparse

actions.name: inspect_formulation
actions.description: Inspect one measured formulation from the current evidence table and compute transparent composition summaries such as total reported amount and resin-modifier fraction when available.
when_to_use: to understand the original design state
to distinguish formulation from process effects

actions.name: get_hold_stability
actions.description: Return measured thermal-hold trajectories and deterministic SI descriptors for a formulation. No extrapolation is performed.
when_to_use: when thermal stability is a design objective
to identify high-drift reference behavior

actions.name: get_repeatability_risk
actions.description: Return nominal repeat/run spread from measured temperature sweeps, including CV and max/min ratio where available.
when_to_use: before trusting a single nominal viscosity
when process-history uncertainty may dominate

actions.name: get_temperature_support
actions.description: Return measured temperature support and descriptive temperature-response summaries for a formulation.
when_to_use: to avoid extrapolation
to check whether a candidate is evaluated inside observed support

actions.name: audit_process_unknowns
actions.description: Audit missing reaction/preparation/hold metadata for a candidate or measured formulation and convert missingness into explicit process-history uncertainty.
when_to_use: before final ranking
when two candidates look similar on nominal composition

actions.name: candidate_profile
actions.description: Compute a transparent candidate profile from its formulation state: total reported amount, polyol fraction, MDI fraction, AC1920+TK100 modifier fraction, and whether the candidate is resin-modified.
when_to_use: for every serious candidate
before comparing a candidate with external priors

actions.name: compare_candidate_to_priors
actions.description: Compare a candidate's modifier fraction with curated literature/patent analogue regions. This is an analogy-support action, not a predicted experimental outcome.
when_to_use: when the candidate contains AC1920/TK100 or another resin modifier
to distinguish supported versus extreme modifier loading

actions.name: stress_test_candidate
actions.description: Apply deterministic risk flags to a candidate using current local failure modes, evidence coverage and external analogue support. It returns reasons, not a fabricated viscosity prediction.
when_to_use: before freezing the recommendation
to expose whether the selection survives robustness checks

actions.name: rank_candidate_support
actions.description: Create a transparent support-oriented ordering using evidence coverage, external analogue support, thermal-hold failure relevance and process-state completeness. This is a decision aid and must not be described as a trained predictive model.
when_to_use: when several candidates remain plausible
to obtain a reproducible pre-LLM ordering

invariants: Actions may expose only evidence allowed by the active evidence-access profile.
Held-out experimental outcomes must never be converted into hints for a blind Agent evaluation.
External analogue evidence is directional prior information, not proof of the current formulation's optimum.
No action may invent a molecular mechanism or an unmeasured viscosity value.
